payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans left to right, maintaining max last occurrence of seen values. At positions where index equals that max, it doubles count; effectively merges intervals of equal values.
payload.rationale: This is a linear sweep over the array, processing interval boundaries defined by first and last occurrences. It's a sweep line technique without explicit sorting because the array order defines interval starts. Among sorting subtypes, sweep_line best fits the interval merging logic.
